segments.text: This Lamborghini Gallardo belongs to Stradman.

segments.speaker: Mat
segments.text: It made 1000 hp before the twin-turbo upgrade.

segments.speaker: Mat
segments.text: Now it makes 1300 hp, not 1000 hp.
